Published on September 4th, 2026


## The best birthday cake delivery options in 2026


The best birthday cakes in America now ship nationwide on Goldbelly. Whether you’re celebrating someone across the country or just want to send something genuinely memorable, these are the cakes worth ordering — from legendary bakeries, celebrity pastry chefs, and iconic institutions that have been perfecting their recipes for decades.


[Browse All Birthday Cakes on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/birthday-cakes)


## **The Best Birthday Cake Delivery Options in 2026**


### **Doan’s Bakery White Chocolate Coconut Bundt Cake**


The cake Tom Cruise sends to his A-list friends every Christmas. Doan’s Bakery in Woodland Hills, California, makes this moist coconut Bundt studded with white chocolate chunks, frosted with cream cheese, and buried in toasted coconut flakes. It’s one of the most talked-about cakes in America, and it ships to your door.


**[Order Doan’s Bakery White Chocolate Coconut Bundt Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/doans-bakery/white-chocolate-coconut-bundt-cake)**


### **Duff Goldman Confetti Birthday Cake**


Duff Goldman, founder of Baltimore’s Charm City Cakes and star of Food Network’s Ace of Cakes, makes a four-layer confetti golden butter vanilla cake with vanilla filling that is exactly what a birthday cake should be. Bright, celebratory, and genuinely delicious. It arrives decorated and party-ready.


**[Order Duff Goldman Confetti Birthday Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/duff-goldman/confetti-birthday-cake)**


### **Flour Shop Rainbow Explosion Cake**


Cut into it and sprinkles pour out. Amirah Kassem’s Flour Shop Explosion Cake has been featured on The Drew Barrymore Show, in Harper’s Bazaar and Glamour, and at countless celebrity birthday parties. Made in Los Angeles, it’s the most theatrical birthday cake in America — choose your flavor (vanilla, cookies n’ cream, or chocolate) and pick your sprinkle color.


**[Order Flour Shop Rainbow Explosion Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/flour-shop/explosion-cake-choose-your-own)**


### **Daisy Cakes Happy Birthday Cake**


Kim Nelson started Daisy Cakes in her grandmother’s kitchen in South Carolina and appeared on Shark Tank Season 2, where Barbara Corcoran invested on the spot. Every Daisy cake is made from scratch with real butter, fresh eggs, and pure vanilla. The Happy Birthday Cake comes in chocolate or vanilla, serves 16 to 20 people, and arrives with the birthday person’s name piped on top in signature birthday buttercream.


**[Order Daisy Cakes Happy Birthday Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/daisy-cakes/happy-birthday-cake)**


### **We Take the Cake Birthday Celebration Golden Butter Layer Cake**


Fort Lauderdale’s most legendary custom cake shop, We Take the Cake has been crafting showstopper cakes by hand since the 1980s. Their Birthday Celebration Golden Butter Layer Cake is a four-layer moist golden butter cake filled and frosted with creamy buttercream, decorated with hand-piped buttercream, a Happy Birthday plaque, and candles. Oprah named their Key Lime Bundt Cake one of her Favorite Things — this cake is in the same league.


**[Order We Take the Cake Birthday Celebration Golden Butter Layer Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/we-take-the-cake/birthday-celebration-golden-butter-layer-cake)**


### **We Take the Cake Birthday Celebration Chocolate Layer Cake**


We Take the Cake’s Birthday Celebration Chocolate Layer Cake was named Best Mail Order Cake by InStyle Magazine. A moist and rich chocolate buttermilk cake filled and frosted with decadent chocolate cream cheese frosting, hand-piped with bright buttercream, and arriving with a Happy Birthday plaque and candles. Every batter and frosting made from scratch using whole milk, fresh eggs, and real butter. Never a cake mix.


**[Order We Take the Cake Birthday Celebration Chocolate Layer Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/we-take-the-cake/birthday-celebration-chocolate-layer-cake)**


### **Mo’s Bundt Cakes Happy Birthday Bundt Cake Gift Box**


Mo’s Bundt Cakes makes some of the most celebrated Bundt cakes in the country. Their Happy Birthday Bundt Cake Gift Box arrives beautifully packaged and ready to give — one of those gifts that looks as good as it tastes.


**[Order Mo’s Bundt Cakes Happy Birthday Bundt Cake Gift Box](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/mos-bundt-cakes/happy-birthday-bundt-cake-gift-box)**


### **Junior’s Famous Brooklyn Cheesecake**


If the birthday person isn’t a cake person, Junior’s is the answer. The Brooklyn institution has been making its signature cheesecake since 1950 using the same recipe Harry Rosen perfected — handmade with fresh premium cream cheese, heavy cream, eggs, and a touch of vanilla, baked atop their signature sponge cake bottom. NY Magazine rated it the best in a blind taste test. The Wall Street Journal called it “Best Overall.” The New York Times called it “the best in the material world.” Ships nationwide in 8″ (serves 12 to 14) or 10″ (serves up to 20).


**[Order Junior’s Famous Brooklyn Cheesecake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/juniors-cheesecake/juniors-original-cheesecake-10)**
